name: Python FastAPI service
description: FastAPI application with SQLAlchemy persistence and pytest tests.
conventions: Application code lives in the app/ package; the FastAPI instance is app.main:app.
Tests live in tests/ and run with `pytest` from the project root (pytest.ini sets pythonpath).
Tests must not need network access or write outside a temporary directory; use an in-memory SQLite database (sqlalchemy.pool.StaticPool) and FastAPI dependency overrides.

Read the database URL from the DATABASE_URL environment variable (default sqlite:///./app.db). Do not create tables at import time; create them in the FastAPI lifespan hook so tests can override the database.
Use only the approved dependencies and the Python standard library. Nothing else is installed in the sandbox.
Read configuration from environment variables with safe defaults; never hard-code secrets.
Use type hints, small functions and clear module boundaries.
